title: Yeasty Syrian Deodeok Root Flatbread
description: A fluffy, yeasty flatbread crowned with grated deodeok root, featuring a double rise for airy pockets and a show‑off presentation.
instructions: In a large bowl whisk together flour, salt, and sugar until well mixed.
In a separate small bowl dissolve the yeast in the warm water and let it sit for 5 minutes until frothy.
Pour the yeast mixture into the dry ingredients and stir until a shaggy dough forms.
Add olive oil and grated deodeok root to the dough and mix until evenly incorporated.
Knead the dough on a lightly floured surface for about 5 minutes until it becomes smooth.
Place the dough in a greased bowl, cover with a damp cloth, and let it rise for 30 minutes at room temperature.
After the first rise, punch the dough down, divide it into six equal portions, and let them rest for 5 minutes.
Roll each portion into a round flatbread about 1/4 inch thick.
Preheat the oven to 220 degrees Celsius and bake the flatbreads for 8 to 10 minutes until golden brown.
Remove from the oven, sprinkle chopped parsley, and serve warm.
